$comment: RP4 title card (D362, user 2026-11-11: 'streamer title fade over a blurred background'). A short title (the streamer brand from data/profile.local.json, never committed) fades in and out over a blurred, darkened copy of the reel behind it. Read by services/clip/reel_title.py. Placed right after the teaser (part 1 of a montage; the payoff-first hook of a reel), else at the very start of the reel. Behind the flag reel-title (off by default). No music yet (RP3 adds the bed that fades out as the title ends). Entrance under 600 ms, exit under 400 ms (overlay rule).
approved: user 2026-11-11 chose the feature; durations, blur, darkness, size and position are the agent's proposal (plan RP4)
why: 1.6 s sits inside the 1.2-1.8 s the user named; the entrance and exit are under the overlay limits (600/400 ms). The blurred layer is a Gaussian blur (ffmpeg gblur, in the LGPL builds; boxblur is not) of the reel itself, darkened to 55 % so a white title reads on any scene. The title is centred in the safe width and the middle of the frame. A reel shorter than minReelSec gets no title.
